item.description: ### Fixed - **The dropdown no longer has an empty band above and below it.** The window kept the height it was first given, often taller than what it showed, and the content sat in the middle of it. It now fits its content exactly and stays tucked under the menu bar as sessions come and go. - **Usage bars show the newest reading.** When both Claude's status line and the account fetch had a figure, the fetched one always won, even when it was several minutes older. The fresher of the two is now shown, and the "almost used up" warning follows it. - **Stats count the work your agents' subagents do.** Tokens spent by subagents — Codex's helper threads and Claude's sub-agents — were left out entirely, which on some Macs was most of the Codex total. They now count toward daily tokens and the model breakdown, and Codex cost includes them. They still don't count as extra sessions. Totals rise the first time you open Stats after updating.
